title: Hypothesis (K4): hat-M_F / M_{F,0+} ≅ hat-K_F / K_{F,0+}
body_html:
Hypothesis (K4)

(K4) The natural map $\hat M_\mathcal{F} \to \hat K_\mathcal{F}$ induces an isomorphism $$\hat M_\mathcal{F} / M_{\mathcal{F}, 0+} \;\xrightarrow{\;\cong\;}\; \hat K_\mathcal{F} / K_{\mathcal{F}, 0+},$$ where $M_{\mathcal{F}, 0+}$ is the pro-unipotent radical of $M_\mathcal{F}$.

(K4) lets us transport actions between $\hat K_\mathcal{F}$ and $\hat M_\mathcal{F}$ modulo pro-$p$ parts; it is required to make the $\Sat$ functor of Res and Sat functors between Coeff_G(B(Σ), Φ) and Coeff_M⁰(B(M)) well-defined.

It is verified in the standard examples — classical groups and tame types — via the explicit description of $K_\mathcal{F}$ in those cases.
